messages.text:
The first implementation is in place, but the local `bash compile.sh` check cannot start because this Windows environment has no `/bin/bash`.

I’m switching verification to the directly runnable Python entrypoint and the generated oracle verifier, then I’ll fix the first real behavioral deltas it exposes.

commands.commandLine: git diff -- xsv_port.py compile.sh executable .tura/script/diff_verify.py | Select-Object -First 240
